scope: Historical b11747 verification; current llama versions and CUDA provenance are in llama-engines.json.
verification: Downloaded archives were checked against upstream digests, then selected entries were streamed through the plugin preparation implementation and checked against every file SHA256 in resources.json. No model weights were downloaded.

engines.layout: llama-server.exe, all supplied DLLs including CPU variants, libomp.dll, mtmd.dll and ggml-vulkan.dll remain colocated.
systemDependencies: Vulkan driver for GPU execution; CPU backend is independently loaded
engines.transport: 127.0.0.1, --port 0, random per-start LLAMA_API_KEY; pinned server's listening announcement supplies the port. Requests carry Bearer authentication; /health itself is public. Linux keeps its Unix socket.

engines.layout: Reuse the unchanged sherpa-onnx-node 1.13.8 wrapper archive; sherpa-onnx-win-x64 keeps its .node addon, ONNX Runtime and sherpa DLLs together under node_modules.
sd-cli.exe and all supplied DLLs, including stable-diffusion, ggml, image codec DLLs and CPU variants, remain colocated; upstream license texts are retained.
systemDependencies: Vulkan-compatible GPU driver and sufficient device memory
engines.configuration: Vulkan0; --flash-attn off,diffusion=on uses the Vulkan workaround without the deprecated --diffusion-fa spelling. Linux retains CUDA0 and its RTX 50 engine.

limitations: The referenced Lemonade revision selects newer llama releases; its platform/layout patterns are references, not proof of b11747 compatibility.
Archive/digest and Linux-host protocol tests are not Windows execution, GPU compatibility, real-weight inference or output-quality evidence.

This historical verification covered Windows x64 Vulkan, not ARM64, CUDA or ROCm. Current CUDA resources are documented in llama-engines.json. No VC++ runtime or GPU driver is installed or modified by this plugin.
External phoneme trees and native engine directory imports must preserve the required relative layout. Model/projector files may remain at independently authorized locations.
